steps.code:
import pandas as pd

# Read all sheets and combine
xls = pd.ExcelFile('/Users/bakulbadwal/Documents/GitHub/gaia-agent/runs/practice_files/p02-xlsx-multisheet-sku/warehouse_stock.xlsx')

all_data = []
for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name=sheet)
    df['Warehouse'] = sheet
    all_data.append(df)

combined = pd.concat(all_data, ignore_index=True)
print("Combined data:")
print(combined.to_string())

# Aggregate by SKU
sku_totals = combined.groupby(['SKU', 'Description'])['Qty On Hand'].sum().reset_index()
sku_totals = sku_totals.sort_values('Qty On Hand', ascending=False)
print("\n\nSKU Totals (sorted by quantity):")
print(sku_totals.to_string())

# Find the SKU with largest total
max_sku = sku_totals.iloc[0]
print(f"\n\nSKU with largest total quantity: {max_sku['SKU']} ({max_sku['Description']}) with {max_sku['Qty On Hand']} units")
